name: Mortis (Corpse in the Monster) — 1 Basic — Masque of Death

system.description:
You can grant yourself or another the appearance of an aged corpse. Expend a Blood Trait. To place the effect upon another, you must touch him (which may call for a Physical Challenge) unless the recipient is willing; otherwise you must defeat her in a Mental Challenge. Once the effect begins, flesh draws taut and the body takes on an entirely corpselike appearance and texture.

Those wearing the Masque of Death are one Trait down on all Social Challenges except intimidation, for which they are one Trait up. They are also one Trait down on Physical Challenges involving flexibility and speed. Seeing through an attempt to emulate a corpse requires a successful Social Challenge. The Masque ordinarily lasts until the next sunset, but the caster may end it earlier.
